name: Private sshd
target: a real ssh login for ELS-SSH-ATTACH-ANYWHERE PTY tests: the current user's own sshd on a free loopback port with throw-away keys in a temp folder, never touching ~/.ssh or the system sshd
inputs: throw-away host and user keys in a temp folder
observations: the current user logs in over a real ssh channel with public-key auth
els-ssh-pty opens a real PTY through it
stop() kills the sshd and removes the temp folder
